content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification advertises a total of 7 contract vacancies across technical and editorial roles. The post-wise breakdown is as follows:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the specific educational and experience requirements prescribed for each post under the Rashtriya e-Pustakalaya Project:

rows.essential_qualification: Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field. 5-8 years in backend development. Proficiency in Node.js / Python / Java / PHP frameworks. Experience with authentication, cloud services, and payment gateway integration. Knowledge of DRM, APIs, microservices, and database handling.

Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field. 5-8 years of Android app development. Strong knowledge of Java/Kotlin, Android SDK, and Android Studio. Experience with APIs, JSON/XML, push notifications, and offline storage. Familiarity with Material Design, responsive UI, Play Store deployment, and performance optimization.

Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field. 5-8 years as a DBA in enterprise-level projects. Proficiency in SQL/NoSQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB). Experience with data security, encryption, and backups. Knowledge of compliance frameworks (GDPR, IT Act, etc.).

Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field. Professional certifications like Microsoft Certified System Administrator (MCSA), Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), or CompTIA Server+/Network+. (preferred). 5-8 years of experience in system/network administration. Hands-on knowledge of Windows/Linux server management, firewalls, and VPNs. Experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Proficiency in backup management, monitoring tools, and troubleshooting. Strong understanding of system security, patch management, and user access control.

Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field. 3-5 years in web frontend development. Strong in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue. Experience with responsive design, accessibility (WCAG), and cross-browser compatibility. Familiarity with API integration, state management, and frontend build tools (Webpack, npm). Knowledge of performance optimization and SEO basics.

Post-graduation in a relevant language from a recognised University with good knowledge of English / Hindi. 3-5 years in editorial review, proofreading, or quality assurance. Proficient in Unicode typing of respective language with a speed of at least 30 wpm. Knowledge of MS Office, Google Suite. An avid reader, a creative writer, strong command of grammar, style, and formatting. Ability to check metadata, categorization, and compliance with publishing guidelines.

Post-graduation in a relevant field from a recognised University with good knowledge of English / Hindi. 3-5 years of proven work experience in Digital content writing & metadata creation in alignment with SEO best practices, press release, articles. Create high-quality descriptions, summaries and promotional blurbs for e-books. Fluent in Hindi, English or additional Indian language. An avid reader and writer.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions are purely on a contract basis through a manpower agency. The tenure is initially for eleven months for senior posts and three months for junior posts, which can be extended as per the requirement of the Trust. The monthly remuneration varies by position: Rs. 80,000/- to Rs. 1,45,000/- for senior posts, Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 80,000/- for Junior Front End Developer Web, and Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 80,000/- for Content Reviewer & Writer posts.

content_sections.heading: National Book Trust Senior Backend Developer Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be required to perform specific roles based on their designated positions: Senior Backend Developer: Design and build core backend systems, including authentication modules, book storage, recommendation engines, and analytics tracking; implement robust content delivery mechanisms and Digital Rights Management (DRM) protocols; optimize server-side performance, database queries, and overall API security. Senior Front End Developer (Android): Build and maintain high-performance Android application interfaces; optimize app performance, speed, and responsiveness across various devices; ensure strict adherence to platform guidelines and usability standards; collaborate closely with backend and design teams; debug and resolve UI/UX issues. Senior Database Administrator: Manage, configure, and optimize enterprise databases for peak performance; ensure strict data security, regular backups, and disaster recovery planning; monitor database performance, query efficiency, and troubleshoot operational issues proactively; handle database migrations, schema updates, and patch implementations. Senior System Administrator: Manage and maintain servers, networks, and overall system infrastructure; ensure high availability, robust security, and regular data backups; monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues proactively; implement user management protocols. Junior Front End Developer Web: Create and maintain responsive, user-friendly web interfaces; ensure seamless cross-browser and multi-device compatibility; optimize frontend performance, rendering speed, and page load times; implement clean UI components based on prototypes and wireframes; debug and resolve frontend, UI/UX, and responsiveness issues. Content Reviewer & Writer (Hindi) & (Multilingual): Review uploaded content for quality, accuracy, and compliance with guidelines; check for plagiarism, copyright, and metadata correctness; ensure proper formatting (ePUB, PDF, MOBI standards); review books for uploading on ReP Platforms; create high-quality descriptions, summaries, and promotional blurbs; draft newsletters, campaign content, and announcements for new titles.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for National Book Trust Senior Backend Developer
content_sections.text: Interested candidates who fulfill the minimum eligibility criteria may apply online through the official National Book Trust, India website at www.nbtindia.gov.in.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 7 vacancies have been announced for various senior and junior technical and editorial posts under the Rashtriya e-Pustakalaya Project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit online applications?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 23 October 2026, which is 10 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. Are these positions permanent or on a contract basis?
faq.answer: These positions are purely on a contract basis through a manpower agency, initially for eleven months for senior posts or three months for junior posts, with possible extension as per the requirement of the Trust.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for Senior Backend Developer?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for the Senior Backend Developer post is up to 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for senior technical posts?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration for senior posts ranges from Rs. 80,000/- to Rs. 1,45,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required to apply?

faq.question: Q7. What is the essential qualification required for Junior Front End Developer Web?
